headlines.title: The 1 Thing To Remember About Your PSA Results During Prostate Cancer Screening
headlines.description: An urologist explains why a PSA test is just the first step in the screening process for prostate cancer screenings. Learn what contributes to your PSA results.

headlines.title: At 61 Years Old, This Grandmother of 12 Broke Her Own World Record With a 5-Hour Plank
headlines.description: A 61-year-old grandmother from Canada has wowed the internet by breaking her own Guinness World Record for longest time planking after holding the position for five hours.

headlines.title: Psychiatrist Shares 9 Depression Symptoms She’d Watch for in Herself: ‘Huge’ Warning Sign
headlines.description: What are the symptoms of depression? A psychiatrist reveals the subtle warning signs she’d monitor in herself such as rumination, irritation and self-neglect.

headlines.title: MAHA fractures deepen as some RFK Jr. followers turn into harsh critics
headlines.description: A scorecard from MAHA activists suggests the Trump administration has broken most of its promises to the movement. The “burn feels especially raw,” one prominent activist said.

headlines.title: The secret to a good night’s rest? Let sleeping dogs lie — next to you
headlines.description: A surprising new study found that people who sleep near their dogs don’t experience disrupted sleep. If anything we humans are the ones disturbing our dogs’ sleep.

headlines.title: How This Teen's Health Journey Shaped Her Passion for Softball
headlines.description: After developing an unprecedented and progressive spinal curvature, known, 10-year-old Macie Perna feared her love for playing softball may be lost forever. But, a life-changing operation at Shriners Children's Philadelphia called Vertebral Body Tethering, or VBT, hit those fears out of the park. Just six weeks later, Perna was back on the field stronger than ever before. Now, at 16, she has no restrictions and big dreams. Macie and her mother Michelle join TODAY's Jenna Bush Hager and Sheinelle

headlines.title: How Clean are Hotel Rooms? What to Know Before Checking in
headlines.description: A hotel room may appear to be squeaky clean but harmful germs could be lurking in places you might not expect. Plush carpets could inhabit E. coli and staph that can hitch a ride on shoes and wheeling suitcases. Reporting for TODAY, NBC’s Vicky Nguyen teams up with an environmental testing lab and books two room in New York City to swab for bacteria and viruses.

headlines.title: How to Set Boundaries at Home and at Work Without the Guilt
headlines.description: Setting boundaries can be difficult and guilt-inducing, but it doesn't have to be. Psychotherapist and author Niro Feliciano joins the 3rd Hour of TODAY to share helpful tips on how to set boundaries in your personal, romantic and work life. She explains how creating limits for yourself can foster healthier relationships and better mental health. "Anyone who has issues with your boundaries," Feliciano says, "they're the people who benefited from you not having them."

headlines.title: Foods to Add to Your Diet for a Healthy and Happy Gut
headlines.description: Maintaining a healthy gut is a vital way to lower risks of illnesses like heart disease and dementia. Gastrointestinal health expert Dr. Trisha Pasricha joins the 3rd Hour of TODAY to share tips to improve gut health, including eating more fiber, diversifying fruits and vegetables in meals, and introducing fermented foods into your diet.

headlines.title: We've tested 10 filtered showerheads (so far) — these are the ones that work
headlines.description: We tested eight filtered shower heads over two years from Jolie, Canopy, Act+Acre and Afina to see which ones really improve hair, skin and water quality.

headlines.title: The most effective over-the-counter products for fading scars
headlines.description: Which scar treatment is best for you? Dermatologists share top scar creams, gels and treatments that actually work to fade scars on your face and body.

headlines.title: We tested over a dozen meal delivery services — these are the ones we recommend
headlines.description: We asked experts for the best meal delivery services in 2026. These are the best meal kit services for everyone from Blue Apron, Home Chef, CookUnity and more.
